title: Purple End (with Stars)
description: Revamps the End Dimension to have prettier skies, purple lighting, and emissive textures.
body:
![A screenshot of the End with the resource pack enabled. Chorus plants are surrounding an End City. The lighting is tinted purple as opposed to green, and the sky is purple with stars.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/501dfd3c272a1f80fb220bb6b57b350bb223dc0e.jpeg)

In short, this resource pack makes the End prettier! No more static skies and dull environments. Once the fog dissipates from the Ender Dragon fight, a beautiful, starry sky emerges.

**This resource pack does NOT do much on its own.** Mods that support certain custom textures are required. Please see "requirements" for more information.

## Features
- Custom purple skybox with stars. These overlay on top of the default "end noise," so both are visible.
- Emissive textures for Chorus Flowers.
- Pink (magenta) fire, exclusive to End biomes.
- Purple ambient lighting...limited to mods that support custom light colors for 1.21.8 and lower, such as Colormatic or Optifine.

## Requirements
- Nuit or Skyboxify. Nuit allows the skybox to rotate, and also supports Nullscape biomes! Only for 1.16.5 and above.
- Continuity, or a mod that supports the CTM format. This makes the fire pink, and the emissive textures slightly brighter than the vanilla ones.
- Colormatic (1.20.1 or lower), or a mod that supports custom lighting colors. Very few mods do this nowadays. I recommend just checking out the [Purple End Lighting](https://modrinth.com/datapack/purple-end-lighting) data pack I made as a rudimentary solution for MC 26.1+.
